title: Suggestions API contract (draft) — Console ↔ Optimize suggestions-service
content:
Owner: Console/Tooling (Felix) w/ Suggestions-service (Applied ML + platform) review
Last reviewed in design/eng sync: 2026-02-16

Purpose
- Define the API contract used by Redwood Console (via BFF) to fetch optimization suggestions (beta read-only): list + detail.
- Contract focuses on: (a) savings estimate payloads and disclosure (“estimated”, not guaranteed), (b) risk taxonomy + rationale, (c) “basis of estimate” telemetry provenance, and (d) pagination/filtering semantics.

Non-goals (beta)
- No “apply” workflow in this contract (phase 2). We include placeholders for future apply eligibility but Console must render read-only.
- No cross-tenant aggregation/export.

Glossary
- Tenant: top-level customer account.
- Workspace: sub-tenant scope used by Console (what users select in the Console UI).
- Route: a Redwood API route (customer-defined logical endpoint/config).
- Suggestion: a recommendation to adjust inference runtime configuration (e.g., caching/batching), scoped to a route/model/region.

High-level architecture notes
- Console UI → Console BFF → suggestions-service.
- Tenant/workspace scoping is enforced server-side (BFF and suggestions-service). Console must NOT send arbitrary tenant IDs in query params.
- suggestions-service sources telemetry from metering + tracing datasets (Logan/Nadia/Mei pipelines). If telemetry is insufficient or stale, the service can return “insufficient_data” state per suggestion or suppress suggestions entirely (see below).

Security / RBAC / audit logging (beta requirements)
- Request is authenticated as Console user session.
- Authorization: requires permission `optimize.suggestions.read` at workspace scope.
- Audit logging: suggestions-service logs read access events (workspace_id, user_id, endpoint, suggestion_ids returned, request_id). Console should propagate `x-request-id`.

API versioning
- Base path includes a coarse API version: `/v1/…`.
- Payload subcomponents also include schema versions for forward/backward compatibility:
  - `savings_estimate.schema_version` (e.g., "1")
  - `risk_assessment.schema_version` (e.g., "1")
- Additive changes are allowed within `v1` (new optional fields). Breaking changes require `/v2`.

Idempotency / caching / freshness
- Endpoints are GET-only; safe to cache at the BFF layer for short TTLs.
- `basis.telemetry_window.end_time` and `basis.baseline.freshness_hours` are the primary UI indicators for staleness.
- Staleness policy (current proposal for beta UI):
  - If baseline freshness > 48h OR telemetry window end_time older than 24h, render savings as “Unavailable” and show reason.

Endpoints

1) List suggestions
GET /v1/suggestions

Query params (all optional)
- `workspace_id` (string) — OPTIONAL if derived from auth context; if present must match auth scope. (BFF likely sets this implicitly; leaving here for service-to-service usage.)
- `route_id` (string)
- `model_id` (string) — e.g., "llama-3.1-70b-instruct"
- `region` (string) — e.g., "us-east-1"
- `suggestion_type` (string) — enum-like; see Suggestion.type
- `risk_level` (string) — one of: "low" | "medium" | "high"
- `state` (string) — one of: "active" | "suppressed" | "expired" (beta: Console shows active only by default)
- `cursor` (string) — opaque pagination cursor
- `limit` (integer) — default 25, max 100

Sorting
- Default sort: highest `savings_estimate.estimated_monthly_usd.mid` desc, then `updated_at` desc.
- Future: allow `sort_by`/`sort_dir` (not in beta unless needed).

Response (200)
- Returns lightweight rows for list/table rendering.

2) Get suggestion detail
GET /v1/suggestions/{suggestion_id}

Query params
- `workspace_id` (string) — OPTIONAL as above.

Response (200)
- Returns full details including rationale bullets, basis-of-estimate telemetry, and additional guardrail fields.

Errors (both endpoints)
- 400 invalid filter (e.g., limit > max)
- 401 unauthenticated
- 403 forbidden (missing permission or workspace mismatch)
- 404 suggestion not found (or not visible in workspace)
- 412 precondition failed / insufficient telemetry (optional behavior; see “insufficient_data” below)
- 429 rate limited
- 5xx service error

Common headers
- Request:
  - `Authorization: Bearer …` (or internal session)
  - `x-request-id: <uuid>`
- Response:
  - `x-request-id: <uuid>`
  - `x-schema-hash: <string>` (optional: helps diagnose mismatched schema during beta)

Data model (conceptual)

Suggestion (summary)
- `id` (string, stable)
- `type` (string)
  - Proposed values (beta):
    - "enable_prefix_caching"
    - "increase_prefix_cache_max_entries"
    - "enable_continuous_batching"
    - "tune_batching_max_batch_tokens"
  - Note: prefer stable, lowercase snake-case; do not encode model/route specifics in type.
- `title` (string) — short UI label
- `summary` (string) — one-sentence explanation
- `state` (string) — "active" | "suppressed" | "expired"
- `created_at` (RFC3339 string)
- `updated_at` (RFC3339 string)

Scope
- `workspace_id` (string)
- `applies_to` (string) — one of: "route" | "route_model" | "route_model_region"
- `route_id` (string)
- `route_name` (string) — convenience for UI; source of truth remains route_id
- `model_id` (string, optional)
- `region` (string, optional)

Recommendation payload
- `recommended_change` (object, conceptually) — WHAT to change, expressed as:
  - `config_target` (string) — e.g., "route"
  - `config_key` (string) — e.g., "caching.prefix.enabled" or "batching.continuous.enabled"
  - `recommended_value` (string) — serialized value ("true", "256", "auto")
  - `current_value` (string, optional) — if known
  - `is_reversible` (string) — "true"/"false" (stringified for this doc; in real JSON it’s boolean)

Savings estimate (ADR-0275 aligned)
- `savings_estimate` (present on summary + detail)
  - `schema_version` (string) — "1"
  - `currency` (string) — "USD"
  - `estimated_unit_usd_per_1m_tokens` (object, conceptually)
    - `baseline_mid` (number)
    - `baseline_low` (number)
    - `baseline_high` (number)
    - `projected_mid` (number)
    - `projected_low` (number)
    - `projected_high` (number)
  - `estimated_monthly_usd` (object, conceptually)
    - `mid` (number)
    - `low` (number)
    - `high` (number)
  - `estimated_savings_usd` (object, conceptually)
    - `mid` (number)
    - `low` (number)
    - `high` (number)
  - `confidence` (object, conceptually)
    - `score_0_to_1` (number)
    - `level` (string) — "low" | "medium" | "high" (NOTE: distinct from risk_level)
    - `notes` (string) — short caveat for UI, e.g., “High traffic variance increases uncertainty.”
  - `savings_sources` (string list) — e.g., ["reduced_prefill_cost", "higher_kv_cache_hit_rate"]
  - `double_counting_guard` (string) — freeform note; service guarantees that two active suggestions do not both claim the same savings for the same mechanism over the same scope.

Risk assessment (ADR-0274 aligned)
- `risk_assessment` (present on summary + detail)
  - `schema_version` (string) — "1"
  - `risk_level` (string) — "low" | "medium" | "high"
  - `risk_dimensions` (string list) — subset of: ["latency", "quality", "reliability", "cost_variance", "operational_reversibility"]
  - `rationale_bullets` (string list) — human-readable reasons shown in detail drawer
  - `assumptions` (string list) — what must remain true for risk to stay bounded
  - `recommended_validation` (string list) — suggested checks (e.g., “Run on staging with long-context prompts”).

Basis of estimate / telemetry provenance
- `basis` (detail endpoint only; summary may include `basis_summary` as a string)
  - `telemetry_window` (object, conceptually)
    - `start_time` (RFC3339)
    - `end_time` (RFC3339)
    - `traffic_slice` (string) — e.g., “prod only; excludes 4xx; includes streaming”
  - `baseline` (object, conceptually)
    - `metric_source` (string) — e.g., "metering.v2" / "tracing.v1"
    - `freshness_hours` (number)
    - `token_count` (number)
    - `request_count` (number)
  - `estimate_method` (string) — e.g., "counterfactual_simulation_v1" / "observational_heuristic_v1"
  - `method_notes` (string) — short human-readable description

Insufficient data handling
- A suggestion may be returned with `state="suppressed"` and `suppression_reason` (detail) for cases like:
  - low volume
  - missing token metering
  - telemetry stale beyond thresholds
  - guardrails detect recent regressions
- Alternative behavior (not preferred for beta): return 412 with a single error. Current UI preference is to show an empty state and/or suppressed rows depending on product decision.

List response schema (v1) — shape
Conceptual shape:
- `items`: list of SuggestionSummary
- `next_cursor`: string or empty
- `as_of`: RFC3339 (when computed)

Detail response schema (v1) — shape
Conceptual shape:
- `suggestion`: SuggestionDetail

NOTE ON JSON IN THIS DOC
This doc includes example JSON. The authoritative schema is owned by suggestions-service; Console/BFF must treat unknown fields as ignorable.

Field-level notes / semantics (gotchas)
- `risk_assessment.risk_level` is NOT the same as `savings_estimate.confidence.level`.
  - Risk: likelihood/impact of negative outcomes if adopted.
  - Confidence: how stable/credible the savings estimate is.
- Savings can be negative at low bound (see batching example). UI must handle negative CI gracefully (e.g., show “$0–$2.1k” vs “-$120–$2.1k” decision TBD).
- `route_name` is optional convenience; if it becomes stale, Console should fetch route metadata from control plane as source of truth.
- If `state="suppressed"`, detail endpoint MUST include `suppression_reason` (string) and `suppression_details` (string) for support/debug.

Proposed additional fields (phase 2 / nice-to-have)
- `actionability`:
  - `is_actionable` (boolean)
  - `blocked_reasons` (string list) — e.g., missing permission, requires private deployment, insufficient headroom
- `evaluation_links`:
  - `eval_report_url` (string)
  - `dashboard_url` (string)

Open questions
1) Do we want a dedicated enum for `suggestion_type` vs using freeform strings? (My preference: freeform strings + docs; treat as enum in UI rendering layer with fallback.)
2) Staleness thresholds: should UI hide estimates beyond 24h or 48h? (SRE prefers stricter; product prefers not too noisy.)
3) Empty state: return 200 with `items=[]` + `empty_reason` vs 412? (Design preference: 200 + reason for better UX.)

Implementation notes (Console/BFF)
- Console should request list with filters (route/model/region) and implement cursor pagination.
- Console must not assume `items.length == limit` implies more pages; use `next_cursor`.
- Treat unknown fields as forward compatible; log schema version mismatches.

Changelog
- 2026-02-16: Added confidence vs risk note; added example with negative low-bound savings; added method_notes_long suggestion.
- 2026-02-10: First cut of schemas + list/detail examples; aligned terminology with ADR-0274/0275.
